Overview

Drammen is a city in Viken with a population of 101,000. A riverside city west of Oslo, known for its successful environmental restoration and growing business community. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
